message.content:
**Short answer:** Yes – you can file a noise complaint with the City of Atlanta. The city’s noise‑enforcement process is handled by the **Atlanta Police Department (APD)** and the **Department of Public Safety (DPS)**, and you can submit a complaint online, by phone, or in person. --- ## How to File a Noise Complaint in Atlanta | Method | What to do | Where to go / Who to call | |--------|------------|---------------------------| | **Online** | • Visit the City of Atlanta’s official website.
• Go to the “Noise Complaint” page (or use the “311” portal).
• Fill out the form with details (date, time, location, description, photos if you have them).
• Submit. | | | **Phone** | • Call the 311 service line (free from any phone).
• Tell the operator you want to file a noise complaint. | 311 (or 404‑727‑3111) | | **In‑person** | • Go to the nearest **City Hall** or **Police Station**.
• Ask for the noise‑complaint form. | City Hall (1200 Peachtree St NW) or any APD precinct | | **Email** | • Send an email to the City’s public safety or code‑enforcement email address. | (check the website for the most current address) | ### What Information Should You Provide? 1. **Date & Time** of the disturbance. 2. **Exact location** (street address or intersection). 3. **Description** of the noise (e.g., loud music, construction, barking dogs). 4. **Duration** (how long it lasted). 5. **Any evidence** (photos, audio recordings, witness statements). 6. **Your contact information** (so the city can follow up). --- ## Atlanta’s Noise Ordinance (Key Points) | Section | What it Covers | Typical Enforcement | |---------|----------------|---------------------| | **§ 10‑1.1** | Prohibits “excessive noise” that disturbs the peace. | APD officers issue warnings, citations, or fines. | | **§ 10‑1.2** | Addresses “construction noise” after 10 p.m. | Construction permits must include noise‑control measures. | | **§ 10‑1.3** | Covers “commercial noise” (e.g., loud music in bars). | DPS monitors compliance; violations can lead to license suspension. | | **§ 10‑1.4** | “Animal noise” (barking dogs, etc.). | DPS can issue citations or require a muzzle. | *For the full text, see the City of Atlanta’s Municipal Code: .* --- ## After You File 1. **Acknowledgment** – You’ll receive a confirmation number (online or by phone). 2. **Investigation** – APD or DPS will investigate. 3. **Resolution** – Depending on severity, they may issue a warning, citation, or order the offending party to stop. 4. **Follow‑up** – If the problem persists, you can re‑file or request a follow‑up inspection. --- ## Quick Links - **City of Atlanta 311 Portal** – - **Noise Complaint Form** – - **Atlanta Police Department** – - **Department of Public Safety** – - **Municipal Code (Noise Ordinance)** – --- ### Bottom Line If you’re experiencing a noise disturbance in Atlanta, you can—and should—report it to the city. Use the 311 system, the online form, or call the police. The city takes noise complaints seriously and has clear procedures to address them.
